best_parts: node fast (skip lane): one diagnostic probe that a confident expert can clear in one tap, with fast_ok routing straight to h, so the path is 4 probes long for experts
node asym: 'Make your call before I explain it' opens with a commitment, and asym_t12 pairs the tempting reason (prevention) with the refutation (most silent stones stay silent)
node e_t24 / e_ok: setting-first reasoning in an ICU acalculous case, with the sure_note naming the habit to unlearn
node i_t20 and j_ok: the bile-duct injury probe links the sequence to the cause (misidentification), so the duct error is tied to the view
flaws: node fast / fast_ok: the fit-patient early-surgery decision restates S5 fit_plan and retest_ok, so the fast lane re-asks a decision the learner has just met
node g: 'organ failure makes surgery unsafe until he is supported' restates the S5 recap (grade III supported and drained first); it adds little new reasoning
node f_t23 / fast/asym traps: the trap 'antibiotics alone suffice' is weak beside 'no stone means milder', so an option is close to dominated
no 'Show me why' (agency) option anywhere, so a learner who misses a trap gets the same wording again on retry, with no second explanation
node f: TR23 is probed only once in the segment, so the trap is not re-tested in a second form

best_parts: node stones: 'No treatment for now; he returns if colic, jaundice or fever begins' gives the learner a concrete return rule, not just 'wait'
node icu_why: asks for the reason after the choice, and icu_why_ok ties fragility to the absence of operative stress
node cvs_t19b: the 'clip the duct early feels careful' tempt-then-refute is short and names the wrong model well
flaws: node pig: the key is the only non-drug option, so a tired student can pick it by elimination; the key is findable by form
nodes cvs, duct, stones, icu_why: the correct option is the longest and most specific label on the screen, which telegraphs the key
traps TR12, TR19, TR20, TR23 and TR24 each appear on one probe only, so there is no re-test in a different form; recovery cannot be shown
no fast lane for a student who already knows the qualifiers; every learner must do all six probes
node icu: the ventilated unfit patient with 'what is the treatment now' restates S5 unfit_plan (support or drainage first); it is a replay, not new drilling
node pig and duct and cvs: no hint option, so a stuck learner has no way to get help on the key probe

best_parts: node stone_t12 and sol_ok: 'Show me why' on a trap jumps to an explanation of the correct model, so a wrong pick gets a second route in
node pred: asks the learner to predict the main risk before the explanation (gangrene and perforation from stasis), then pred_ok explains it
node seq_t1 and injury_ok: the order probe and the injury probe re-test TR19 and TR20 in different forms (sequence, then recognition), so recovery can be shown
node cvs_ok: states the three requirements plainly and says why the count alone does not prove the view
flaws: no fast lane: every learner works all nine probes; an expert cannot skip the stone and TG18 material already known
node pro_t1 and pro_t2: 'Show me why' returns to pro_ok, which only gives the porcelain answer and does not explain why a 2 cm stone is not an indication
node prophylaxis and sol and cvs: the correct option is the longest label, which telegraphs the key
node grade3: 'organ support first' restates the S5 recap; the replay adds no new decision
node sick: the ICU ventilated-patient probe repeats S5 unfit_plan; it is a replay with a different patient
nodes prophylaxis, cvs, injury: no hint option on the probe, so a stuck learner has no help route

merge_ideas: a's fast lane (skip to the operative check) with c's 'Show me why' routes on trap feedback, so an expert skips and a novice still gets a second explanation
c's sequence and recognition re-tests of TR19 and TR20 added to a's path so every trap appears on two probes in two forms
b's concrete return rule ('he returns if colic, jaundice or fever begins') as the correct-feedback line in a's asym and c's stone_ok
give the ICU and grade III probes a new stem (not the S5 ventilated-hypotensive pattern), e.g. a stone-free patient on the ward, to avoid replaying S5
add a hint option to every key probe (c's prophylaxis, cvs, injury; b's pig, duct) and make the correct option no longer the longest label
